pages.text: Boots that make you $(l)hover over the ground$(), following the terrain like a hovercraft. Steps and slabs disappear under you, you glide over water and lava without touching them, and you take $(l)no fall damage$().

Make them at the $(l:trinkets/trinket_table)Trinket Table$(/l) and wear them in the $(l)Feet$() slot. They run on the $(l:trinkets/energy_sphere)Energy Sphere$(/l) in your $(l:trinkets/utility_belt)Utility Belt$(/l).

$(li)Press $(l)H$() to pick the hover height: $(l)0.5$(), $(l)1$() or $(l)2 blocks$(), or off. Each press moves to the next.$(br)$(li)$(l)Sneak to land.$()$(br)$(li)$(l)Step assist$(): a step up to a full block high rises under you as you reach it, smoothly, at any hover height. You never bump into a single block.
pages.title: Using them

pages.text: $(li)Walking, sprinting and jumping work as on foot. You stop and turn with a touch of drift, as on a little ice.$(br)$(li)Rings of light leave your soles and sink to the ground under you.$(br)Off a cliff, the field slows you down and catches you at your height above the ground below.
$(li)$(l)Heights$(): 0.5, 1 or 2 blocks$(br)$(li)$(l)Speed while hovering$(): +40%$(br)$(li)$(l)Power$(): 12 FE/t while you hover$(br)$(li)$(l)Full Energy Sphere$(): about 35 minutes of hovering
pages.title: Numbers

pages.text: They do not hover when:$(br)$(li)the Energy Sphere is empty, or missing from your belt;$(br)$(li)the height is set to off;$(br)$(li)you are flying in creative, gliding with an elytra, riding, sleeping or in spectator mode.
